name: Stone Harbor
question_title: Can you drive a golf cart in Stone Harbor?
answer_short: Street-legal LSVs yes, plain golf carts no. In Stone Harbor, registered LSVs may use roads posted 25 mph or less and cross faster roads at intersections.

rules.rule: Plain golf carts aren't street-legal; only titled, registered and insured LSVs that meet 49 CFR 571.500
LSVs only on roads posted 25 mph or less; they may cross faster roads at intersections
Borough ordinance on LSV rentals and taxis

banned_roads.name: Roads posted over 25 mph (e.g. Ocean Drive, Route 47)

faq.q: Where can I drive my LSV in Stone Harbor?
faq.a: Roads posted 25 mph or less. Local LSV ordinances apply. A town or county can still ban LSVs from a specific road, and posted signs win.

faq.q: Can I drive a regular golf cart in Stone Harbor?
faq.a: No. New Jersey only lets titled, registered and insured LSVs on public roads.

faq.q: How fast can a road be for an LSV in Stone Harbor?
faq.a: 25 mph or less, unless the town, county or NJDOT has opened it to LSVs up to 35 mph.
